title: Services with dependency injection
description:
Wire a small app through interfaces so its parts can be swapped.

```
[real clock] Good afternoon, Ada!
[fake clock 08:00] Good morning, Ada!
```
hints: `Greeter` only knows `IClock`; the code that creates it decides which clock to pass in (lesson 6.03).
requirements: `interface IClock { DateTime Now { get; } }` with `SystemClock` and `FakeClock(DateTime now)`.
`class Greeter(IClock clock)` greets by the hour: before 12 morning, before 18 afternoon, otherwise evening.
Build the greeter twice: once with the real clock, once with a fake one, without changing `Greeter`.
stretch: Add a `Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection`-style registry of your own: `Register<TService>(Func<TService>)` and `Get<TService>()`.
